title: Eliminating Make-Whole Uplifts with a Minimum-Cost Uniform Price Adder
abstract: arXiv:2611.27757v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Co-optimizing energy and flexible ramping reserves may dispatch generators at locational marginal prices (LMPs) below their submitted energy offer prices, necessitating out-of-market make-whole payments. Such payments create discriminatory settlements among generators and may incentivize strategic bidding for higher profits. This paper proposes LMP+U, an in-market uniform price adder to LMP for transmission-constrained networks, which minimizes demand payments subject to zero out-of-market make-whole uplift, preserves LMP-based congestion charges, and provides locally truthful bidding incentives for price-taking generators. We also identify conditions under which a price-taking generator can increase its profit by inflating its energy offer under conventional LMP with make-whole uplift. Numerical simulations illustrate the properties of LMP+U and its advantages over conventional LMP in congested networks.

translated_title: 基于最小成本统一价格附加器消除全额补偿
translated_abstract: 联合优化电能与灵活爬坡备用可能使发电机以低于其申报电能报价的节点边际价格（LMP）出清，从而需要市场外的全额补偿付款。此类付款在发电机之间造成差别化结算，并可能激励其进行策略性报价以获取更高利润。本文提出了 LMP+U，一种面向输电约束网络的在 LMP 之上的市场内统一价格附加器，其在市场外全额补偿为零的约束下最小化需求方支付，保留了基于 LMP 的阻塞费用，并为价格接受型发电机提供局部真实的报价激励。我们还识别了在带有全额补偿的传统 LMP 机制下，价格接受型发电机通过抬高其电能报价即可增加利润的条件。数值仿真展示了 LMP+U 的特性及其在阻塞网络中相对于传统 LMP 的优势。
tldr: 本文提出市场内统一价格附加器 LMP+U，可在将市场外全额补偿降为零的同时最小化需求方支付，保留基于 LMP 的阻塞费用，并为价格接受型发电机提供局部真实的报价激励，从而消除市场外补偿付款。
